senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
1 A blanket.
2 An eye-lash.
3 A sort of deer.
E.
रम to please, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् with the final dropped रत् comfort, pleasure, ला to give, aff. क्विप्-रल्ल, and कन् added.

m. (-लः)
Resin, the resinous and fragrant exudation of the Shorea robusta.
E.
रा to give or get, aff. अलच्; also अराल.
